title: Base change distributes over tensor products of modules
statement:
Let $\varphi:A\to B$ be a homomorphism of commutative rings, and for an $A$-module $P$ write $P\otimes_AB$ for its base change, a $B$-module. For $A$-modules $M,N$ there is an isomorphism of $B$-modules
$$\delta_{M,N}:(M\otimes_AN)\otimes_AB\;\xrightarrow{\ \sim\ }\;(M\otimes_AB)\otimes_B(N\otimes_AB),\qquad (m\otimes n)\otimes b\mapsto(m\otimes b)\otimes(n\otimes1),$$
in particular $(m\otimes n)\otimes1\mapsto(m\otimes1)\otimes(n\otimes1)$, natural in $M$ and $N$: for $A$-linear $u:M\to M'$, $v:N\to N'$ one has $\delta_{M',N'}\circ((u\otimes v)\otimes\mathrm{id}_B)=((u\otimes\mathrm{id}_B)\otimes(v\otimes\mathrm{id}_B))\circ\delta_{M,N}$.

source.place: Algebra, Section 10.12 (Tag 00CV, label section-tensor-product): commutativity (Tag 00CY, label lemma-flip-tensor-product) and the bimodule associativity (Tag 00D2, label lemma-tensor-with-bimodule) give $(M\otimes_AN)\otimes_AB\cong M\otimes_A(N\otimes_AB)\cong (M\otimes_AB)\otimes_B(N\otimes_AB)$; the identity is used in Modules, proof of Tag 01CD (lemma-tensor-product-pullback) via stalks
